creator.appliesPose: Sending a request switches to Clip, where the result plays. A keyframe's pose you changed is applied first. An unsaved pose of its own has to be saved or discarded before.
creator.changedMeanwhile: The timeline changed while the assistant worked, so its result was not applied and the assistant was stopped. Send your request again to work from the timeline as it is now.
creator.keepsEffects: Effects and sounds on the timeline stay as they are.
creator.notApplied: The assistant's result could not be applied to this item.
creator.poseDraft: Pose mode holds an unsaved pose that the assistant's result would replace, so nothing was sent or applied. Save the pose or discard it, then send your request again.

revises.gesture: Your request changes the Gesture open here. Undo puts it back.
revises.reaction: Your request changes the Reaction open here. Undo puts it back.

creator.running: Leave the timeline as it is while the assistant works. A result is not applied over a timeline that changed meanwhile.
creator.setup: The assistant needs a model before it can work here. Choose one on the Generate page.

warnings.avatarOnlyExpressions: Plays only on Avatars that have these expressions: {{names, list}}.

contact.fail: A hand misses the spot it is meant to touch.
contact.warn: A hand is slightly off the spot it is meant to touch.

feet.fail: A planted foot slides or lifts.

fingers.warn: Fingers come close to passing through each other.

intersection.fail: Body parts pass through each other.
intersection.warn: Body parts come close to passing through each other.

warnings.issue: Part of the clip is not valid.

loopSeam.fail: The end of the loop does not match its start.
loopSeam.warn: The loop jumps a little where it repeats.

warnings.missingExpressions: The chosen Avatar cannot show these expressions: {{names, list}}.

oscillation.fail: A body part shakes back and forth too fast.
oscillation.warn: A body part moves back and forth quickly.

parity.fail: The motion comes out differently on the two Included Avatars.
parity.warn: The motion comes out slightly differently on the two Included Avatars.

pose.fail: A pose the draft uses could not be found.
pose.warn: A pose the draft uses may not look right.

range.fail: A joint bends further than a body can.
range.warn: A joint bends further than looks natural.

smoothness.warn: A movement is a little abrupt.

unknown.warn: A motion check raised a warning.
